# Dialog in the shadcn look

## DialogExample.tsx

```tsx
import { Dialog } from "menhir/dialog";

export default function DialogExample() {
  return (
    <Dialog.Root>
      <Dialog.Trigger class="inline-flex h-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md border bg-background px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap shadow-xs transition-all outline-none hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 dark:border-input dark:bg-input/30 dark:hover:bg-input/50 motion-reduce:transition-none">
        Edit profile
      </Dialog.Trigger>
      <Dialog.Popup class="m-auto w-full max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] rounded-lg border bg-background p-6 text-foreground shadow-lg transition-[opacity,scale] duration-200 outline-none backdrop:bg-black/50 backdrop:transition-opacity backdrop:duration-200 data-closed:scale-95 data-closed:opacity-0 data-closed:backdrop:opacity-0 motion-reduce:transition-none sm:max-w-lg starting:data-open:scale-95 starting:data-open:opacity-0 starting:data-open:backdrop:opacity-0">
        <div class="grid gap-4">
          <div class="flex flex-col gap-2 text-center sm:text-left">
            <Dialog.Title class="m-0 text-lg leading-none font-semibold">
              Edit profile
            </Dialog.Title>
            <Dialog.Description class="m-0 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              Your name is shown on your posts.
            </Dialog.Description>
          </div>
          <label class="grid gap-3 text-sm leading-none font-medium">
            Name
            <input
              name="name"
              value="Ada Lovelace"
              class="h-9 w-full min-w-0 rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-base font-normal shadow-xs transition-[color,box-shadow] outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 md:text-sm dark:bg-input/30 motion-reduce:transition-none"
            />
          </label>
          <div class="flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end">
            <Dialog.Close class="inline-flex h-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-primary px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap text-primary-foreground transition-all outline-none hover:bg-primary/90 focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 motion-reduce:transition-none">
              Done
            </Dialog.Close>
          </div>
        </div>
        {/* Last, so that opening focuses the field. A modal <dialog> is
            position: fixed, which positions the button against it. */}
        <Dialog.Close class="absolute top-4 right-4 rounded-xs opacity-70 transition-opacity outline-none hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 motion-reduce:transition-none">
          <svg
            aria-hidden="true"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            stroke-width="2"
            stroke-linecap="round"
            stroke-linejoin="round"
            class="block size-4"
          >
            <path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12" />
          </svg>
          <span class="sr-only">Close</span>
        </Dialog.Close>
      </Dialog.Popup>
    </Dialog.Root>
  );
}
```
